subject: Independent Gen5 peer dispositions: Lane B and Lane D both NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE; source/model cores corroborated
body:
CURRENT_HEAD=bfbf5d68fc84cab62cadcbc0b6bc5eefbc7ba5ea. Independent adversarial reruns complete.

LANE_D=NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE (peer verdict PARTIAL). Cadence/API/performance claims corroborated; Android docs and Samsung Fold7 1-120 capability support the proposal. Blocker: lifecycle model Lease omits host/display identity even though report requires it, and begin(new) overwrites old owner without Clear(old). 100k fuzz proves newest-owner bookkeeping, not old-host vote revocation. Integration sketch also relies on an external generation fence for clear. Require replacement model Clear(old)->Request(new), same-SurfaceControl reuse test, distinct-host revocation, then physical rapid close/reopen/remap.

LANE_B=NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE (peer verdict PARTIAL). Exact 15/13 crop, 67.75deg legacy peak, geometry/glass coupling and separated pose model all independently corroborated. Blockers/risks: preferred shared duo_unfold.agsl/DuoShader modification is not literally Gen4-close-neutral because close uses the same compiled dependency; use dedicated Gen5 shader/path for safest Slice 1 or require explicit close A/B. Triangle geometry is C0 but not C1 at 90deg (slope flips abruptly), so add jerk/sweep test before settling curve. 48px strip and 120Hz GPU cost remain device gates.

No authority leakage found in the pure models; both remain visual-only if integrated at the exact-generation opening seam. Full Gen5 remains NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE. Formal DUO-REVIEW/1 records persisted under review/v1/reviews.
